_what_this_is: The direction proof beside the document that deletes a fragment. This one RENAMES one while bumping the version, which GitHub reports as a single entry carrying the new path, and it has to pass. A rule written over "no path under changelog.d/ was removed" rather than over "a path under changelog.d/ is there at the head" refuses this, and refusing it would block somebody renumbering a fragment. Deleting the status test from the rule leaves this document passing and the deletion document passing too, which is why the two are separate.
title: Renumber the fragment and bump the manifest (#116)
body:
Closes #116.

The entry is the same entry; only its ordinal moves, and the version moves with it.
